_comment: Milestone 4 accuracy audit (15 Nov 2026, IST). One entry per source: how it was checked. 'fetched' = page text downloaded and the claim found in it; 'search' = the site blocks scripted fetches, so the claim was checked in search-engine extracts of the maker's page and the edge is held at medium. Per-edge results that differ from 'Verified' are in 'edges', keyed item|domain|standard-or-watts. scripts/build_audit.py turns this plus items.json into the table in docs/DATA.md.

edges.cable-dp8k|video|DP-1.4-HBR3: FIXED: was DP 2.1 UHBR10 (38.69 Gbps). VESA certifies DP8K at 4-lane HBR3 (25.92 Gbps data). Still enough for 4K60.
edges.cable-hdmi-high-speed|video|HDMI-1.4: DOWNGRADED high to medium: hdmi.org lists 10.2 Gbps, but the HDMI 2.0 release says Category 2 cables carry 18 Gbps. Kept the conservative 10.2 Gbps.
edges.cable-tb4|video|DP-Alt-4L-HBR3: RE-SOURCED from Wikipedia to Apple's Thunderbolt cable page (HBR3 video).
edges.cable-tb4|power|USB-PD-5A: RE-SOURCED from Wikipedia to Apple's Thunderbolt cable page (100 W).
edges.cable-dp-hbr2|video|DP-1.2-HBR2: RE-SOURCED from Wikipedia to VESA (DPv1.2 = HBR2).
edges.adp-dp-hdmi-active|video|HDMI-2.0: DOWNGRADED high to medium: many adapters sold as 'active' are 4K30; the class only holds if the box says 4K60.
edges.mbp14-m3|video|HDMI-2.0: Verified (Apple documents 4K120 over HDMI); modelled lower at the HDMI 2.0 rate, which covers every mode here.
edges.x1c-g12|video|DP-Alt-4L-HBR3: Verified port; PSREF says DisplayPort 2.1 without a UHBR rate, so held at HBR3 and medium.
edges.iphone-15|video|DP-Alt-2L-HBR2: Source says 'up to 4K HDR' with no refresh rate; modelled conservatively at 4K30, low confidence.
edges.iphone-15-pro|video|DP-Alt-2L-HBR2: Source says 'up to 4K HDR' with no refresh rate; modelled conservatively at 4K30, low confidence.
edges.iphone-16|video|DP-Alt-2L-HBR2: Source says 'up to 4K HDR' with no refresh rate; modelled conservatively at 4K30, low confidence.
edges.pixel-8|video|DP-Alt-2L-HBR2: Google confirms wired display output on Pixel 8+, no resolution; low confidence.
edges.galaxy-s24|video|DP-Alt-2L-HBR2: Samsung confirms HDMI/DeX output, no resolution; low confidence.
edges.galaxy-tab-s9|video|DP-Alt-2L-HBR2: Samsung confirms HDMI/DeX output, no resolution; low confidence.
edges.ipad-10|video|DP-Alt-2L-HBR2: Verified limit (4K30 or 1080p60); the 2-lane HBR2 rate matching it is our inference, so medium.
edges.proj-epson-2250u|video|HDMI-1.4: Verified 1080p over HDMI; HDMI version not published, so medium.
edges.proj-epson-118|video|HDMI-1.4: Verified HDMI inputs and XGA panel; HDMI version not published, so medium.
edges.proj-xga-vga|video|VGA-1200p: Class; 720p input on an XGA projector is assumed (low). Real example: Epson PowerLite 118.
edges.cable-vga|video|VGA-1200p: Analog; no spec body publishes a cable limit. Kept low.
edges.mon-portable-1080p|video|DP-Alt-2L-HBR3: Class; lane count rarely published. Kept low.
edges.std|HDMI-1.4: RE-SOURCED from Wikipedia to hdmi.org (HDMI 1.4b: 4K30). Wikipedia is kept only for the 8b/10b arithmetic.
edges.std|HDMI-2.0: RE-SOURCED to the HDMI 2.0 release (18 Gbps, 4K60); hdmi.org/spec/hdmi2_0 now returns 404.
edges.std|HDMI-2.1-FRL: RE-SOURCED to the Ultra High Speed cable page (48 Gbps); the old HDMI 2.1 URL now shows HDMI 2.2.
edges.std|DP-1.2-HBR2: RE-SOURCED from Wikipedia to VESA (DPv1.2 = HBR2, 5.4 Gbps/lane).
edges.std|DP-1.4-HBR3: RE-SOURCED from Wikipedia to VESA (DPv1.4 = HBR3, 8.1 Gbps/lane).
edges.std|DP-2.1-UHBR10: RE-SOURCED to VESA. No catalog edge uses it any more (DP8K was moved to HBR3).
edges.std|DP-2.1-UHBR13.5: ADDED for the DP54 cable (VESA). Data rate after 128b/132b and FEC from Wikipedia.
edges.std|DP-Alt-4L-HBR2: ADDED for DisplayPort 1.2 USB-C ports and 5 Gbps cables.
edges.std|DP-Alt-2L-HBR2: ADDED; VESA's slide gives 2-lane HBR2 = 4K30, matching Apple's iPad 10 limit.
edges.std|USB-PD-3A: RE-SOURCED from Wikipedia to USB-IF (20 V at 3 A is the 60 W cable rating).
edges.std|USB-PD-5A: RE-SOURCED from Wikipedia to USB-IF PD (100 W at 20 V/5 A).
edges.std|VGA-1200p: No spec body publishes this; Wikipedia only. Kept medium.
edges.std|HDMI-Standard-cable: Verified (Standard cable tested for 720p/1080i). Medium: many pass more, uncertified.
